title: Rotate Image
statement:
You are given an n × n 2D matrix representing an image. Rotate the image 90 degrees clockwise in-place.

You must modify the matrix directly without using extra space for another 2D matrix (though you may use O(1) extra space for variables).

visibleExamples.explanation: After rotating 90 degrees clockwise, the matrix becomes [[7,4,1],[8,5,2],[9,6,3]]. The matrix is modified in-place.
After rotating 90 degrees clockwise, the matrix becomes [[3,1],[4,2]]. The matrix is modified in-place.

jsonFriendlyReason: All parameters and return type are JSON-representable (list[list[int]] and None).
